_comment: Website shop catalogue -> Stripe Products, Prices and Payment Links (stripe_catalog.py). Amounts are SGD cents. `inferred: true` = not published on the site yet; confirm before running against the live key. `enabled: false` items are skipped. Private Pilates prices are the introductory ones (offer ends 30 Nov 2026). Placeholder prices (cpsc, prenatal/postnatal courses, socks) stay `inferred` until confirmed, so a live run skips them.
